# Fused GEMM chains (model only, generated by `python3 -m armse.fusionbench`)

Fused = row blocks of `tm` rows; the requantised INT8 intermediate (tm x N1) lives in the A buffer; B1/B2 are re-streamed per block. Unfused = two independent D_feedback programs. Cycle ratio < 1 means fusion is faster. Barriers between phases/blocks and per-tile requantisation cost are included, which penalises fusion (conservative). Functional check: 20/20 fused configurations bit-exact vs an independent numpy reference (including requantisation).
